_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Headless History#000.src: You should check your content book to see what to do next.

A Headless History#001.src: I left {p} behind, to aid in her "battle" against the darkness. What a fool I was.

A Headless History#002.src: Six hundred years of searching finally brought us to what we so foolishly sought... And we were unprepared.
A Headless History#002.dst: Seiscientos años de búsqueda nos llevaron por fin a lo que tan neciamente buscábamos... Y no estábamos preparados.

A Headless History#003.src: That sparkle of light seems to lead down the side path. It feels somehow desperate...?
A Headless History#003.dst: Ese destello de luz parece guiar por el camino lateral. Se siente... ¿desesperado?

A Headless History#004.src: It almost seems like he wants to say something, even though his expression is blank.
A Headless History#004.dst: Casi parece que quiere decir algo, aunque su expresión está vacía.

A Headless History#005.src: Despite this, he isn't responding to you. He looks almost soulless...
A Headless History#005.dst: Aun así, no te responde. Parece casi desalmado...

A Headless History#007.dst: ¿Es Referick el que está ahí abajo..?

A Headless History#009.src: You are NOT dying on me! I won't allow it! You will LIVE, you hear me? !
A Headless History#009.dst: ¡NO te vas a morir! ¡No lo permitiré! ¡VIVIRÁS, ¿me oyes?!

A Headless History#010.src: At this moment...I believed that I could protect her. I believed that I could aid her.
A Headless History#010.dst: En ese momento... creí que podía protegerla. Creí que podía ayudarla.

A Headless History#011.src: You've been trying to find "another way" for two centuries. Don't you think it's high-time we took my route, before things get worse?
A Headless History#011.dst: Llevas dos siglos buscando "otra forma". ¿No crees que ya es hora de seguir mi camino, antes de que todo empeore?

A Headless History#012.src: As the darkness slowly seeped into the land, her stubbornness halted any progress we might have made.
A Headless History#012.dst: Mientras la oscuridad se filtraba lentamente en la tierra, su terquedad frenó cualquier avance posible.

A Headless History#013.src: Years of searching to no avail- A strong enough attack would have ended it, but her foolish pacifism doomed us.
A Headless History#013.dst: Años de búsqueda en vano- Un ataque fuerte habría acabado con ello, pero su necio pacifismo nos condenó.

A Headless History#014.src: The creature was found hibernating underground... It had been storing power, and we found ourselves utterly outmatched.
A Headless History#014.dst: Hallamos a la criatura hibernando bajo tierra... Había acumulado poder, y nos superaba por completo.

A Headless History#015.src: The sacrifices I made for her can never be measured. Despite that... once I had outlived my usefulness, I was tossed away like old clothing and left to collect dust.
A Headless History#015.dst: Los sacrificios que hice por ella no tienen medida. Aun así... en cuanto dejé de serle útil, me desechó como ropa vieja y me dejó cogiendo polvo.

A Headless History#016.src: Instead, it will free you from your very life. I have had enough of your meddling.
A Headless History#016.dst: En cambio, te liberará de tu propia vida. Ya me he cansado de tus intromisiones.

A Headless History#017.src: She had the power and the opportunity to kill it ten times over, but clung to her morals. She could not recognize necessity, and refused to heed my offers and warnings.
A Headless History#017.dst: Tenía el poder y la ocasión de matarla diez veces, pero se aferró a su moral. No supo ver lo necesario y desoyó mis ofertas y advertencias.

A Headless History#018.src: And so, my dark agony began. The light began to siphon away from me. I found myself paranoid and addled, fearful that my disfigurement would be seen.
A Headless History#018.dst: Y así empezó mi oscura agonía. La luz se escapaba de mí. Me volví paranoico y confuso, temiendo que vieran mi deformidad.

A Headless History#019.src: Even still I held some misplaced faith in her. With that dark seed in my mind... It grew to an obsession, almost- I had to hide it. I had to hide my curse. But it was found...
A Headless History#019.dst: Aun así seguía teniendo una fe equivocada en ella. Con esa semilla oscura en la mente... Se volvió casi una obsesión- Tenía que ocultarlo. Ocultar mi maldición. Pero la descubrieron...

A Headless History#020.src: All of you, welcome! Today will be the day we save our fair land. Today's the day of light!
A Headless History#020.dst: ¡Bienvenidos todos! Hoy es el día en que salvaremos nuestra bella tierra. ¡Hoy es el día de la luz!

A Headless History#021.src: The people of {p} saw my cursed visage... They saw me near the dark scars. They assumed without thought, and turned me into a perfect scapegoat.
A Headless History#021.dst: La gente de {p} vio mi rostro maldito... Me vieron junto a las cicatrices oscuras. Lo dieron por hecho y me hicieron el chivo expiatorio perfecto.

A Headless History#022.src: Not even death saw the end of my misfortunes. Not even a final release such as this could save me from Lari's stubbornness and endless mistakes.
A Headless History#022.dst: Ni la muerte puso fin a mis desgracias. Ni siquiera un descanso final como ese me libró de la terquedad de Lari y sus errores sin fin.

A Headless History#023.src: She brought me back...but the dark infection had eroded away my mind, my soul, my magic, and it continued to ravage my body. Every part of me, the dark touched.
A Headless History#023.dst: Ella me trajo de vuelta... pero la infección oscura había carcomido mi mente, mi alma, mi magia, y seguía asolando mi cuerpo. La oscuridad tocó cada parte de mí.

A Headless History#024.src: Her soft light burned in me, as the darkness quashed it and filled in the emptiness that it had created. I was there...but you could not say I was the same person.
A Headless History#024.dst: Su suave luz ardía en mí, mientras la oscuridad la sofocaba y llenaba el vacío que había dejado. Yo seguía allí... pero no era la misma persona.

A Headless History#025.src: I could feel nothing. She still made me feel...but only annoyance. Rage. Sorrow. I could not bear to be with her a moment longer.
A Headless History#025.dst: No sentía nada. Ella aún me hacía sentir... pero solo fastidio. Ira. Pena. No soportaba estar con ella ni un momento más.

A Headless History#026.src: There is no fixing this. Her actions are doomed to failure, just as I saw. She has not returned since this time... And so she did not realize that her actions have done little.
A Headless History#026.dst: Esto no tiene arreglo. Sus actos están condenados al fracaso, como yo vi. No ha vuelto desde entonces... Y por eso no sabe lo poco que han servido.

A Headless History#027.src: The very powers she bestowed me with, knowingly or not...allow me to command spirits as I wish. To have those who doomed me to this purgatory feel the same aches as I have.
A Headless History#027.dst: Los poderes que me otorgó, a sabiendas o no... me permiten dominar espíritus a mi antojo. Que quienes me condenaron a este purgatorio sufran mi mismo dolor.

A Headless History#028.src: To have their minds, bodies, and souls wracked. To have their magic outlawed and wither in disuse.
A Headless History#028.dst: Que su mente, su cuerpo y su alma sean atormentados. Que su magia sea prohibida y se marchite sin uso.

A Headless History#029.src: Each soul I consume fills me with new strength. And none can reach me- Lari herself saw to that. Would she have taken action, had she known?
A Headless History#029.dst: Cada alma que consumo me llena de nueva fuerza. Y nadie puede alcanzarme- Lari se encargó de ello. ¿Habría actuado de haberlo sabido?

A Headless History#030.src: There is truly, finally, nothing more for you here. The spell can not be broken, as of now. You have seen my life laid bare in front of you. There is nothing more for you to see.
A Headless History#030.dst: Ya no hay de verdad nada más para ti aquí. El hechizo no se puede romper, por ahora. Has visto mi vida al desnudo ante ti. No queda nada más que ver.

A Headless History#032.src: Talk to Hans in the {p} outskirts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Headless History#032.dst: Habla con Hans en las afueras de {p} en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#033.src: Oi, you there! With the small nose and whatnot! I got somethin' to ask you. Got a minute?
A Headless History#033.dst: ¡Eh, tú! ¡El de la nariz pequeña y tal! Tengo que preguntarte algo. ¿Tienes un minuto?
A Headless History#033.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#034.src: Good, you're good people. It's about our neighbor, Referick. He's a bit of a conspiracy nut. You know the type, villager illuminati, Wybels are evil, all that?
A Headless History#034.dst: Bien, eres buena gente. Es por nuestro vecino, Referick. Es un poco conspiranoico. Ya sabes, illuminati aldeanos, los Wybels son malvados, todo eso.
A Headless History#034.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#035.src: He's acting proper strange though, the past few days. Thinkin' a lord of time's draggin' creatures from other dimensions doesn't make ya stop eatin' or drinkin'.
A Headless History#035.dst: Pero lleva unos días muy raro. Creer que un señor del tiempo trae bichos de otras dimensiones no hace que dejes de comer y beber.
A Headless History#035.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#036.src: He'll talk your ear off about it if you give him half a chance, but he ain't sayin' a word to me, even when I tried askin' about his theories.
A Headless History#036.dst: Te suelta el rollo en cuanto le das media ocasión, pero a mí no me dice ni pío, ni cuando le pregunté por sus teorías.
A Headless History#036.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#037.src: Somethin's definitely wrong about him, that much's for sure. Could ya take a look for me, see whatcha can figure out and all?
A Headless History#037.dst: Algo le pasa, eso seguro. ¿Podrías echarle un vistazo por mí, a ver qué averiguas y tal?
A Headless History#037.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#038.src: He lives in the house next to the pile of rocks. He's got screws loose but I don't want 'im dyin' on me, yeah?
A Headless History#038.dst: Vive en la casa junto al montón de rocas. Le falta un tornillo, pero no quiero que se me muera, ¿vale?
A Headless History#038.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#039.src: Talk to Referick in his house and head upstairs at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Headless History#039.dst: Habla con Referick en su casa y sube arriba en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#041.src: Oi! Any luck with ol' Rick there?
A Headless History#041.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#042.src: ...hm. Dang it...y'know, maybe there's somethin' here that'll tell us what in heck happened.
A Headless History#042.dst: ...mm. Vaya... ¿sabes?, a lo mejor aquí hay algo que nos diga qué demonios ha pasado.
A Headless History#042.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#043.src: Let's look around the house for anythin' he mighta been workin' on. Maybe he finally fiddled with somethin' he shouldn'ta fiddled with?
A Headless History#043.dst: Busquemos por la casa algo en lo que estuviera trabajando. ¿Y si por fin trasteó con algo que no debía?
A Headless History#043.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#044.src: Investigate his house for clues as to what could have happened.
A Headless History#044.dst: Investiga su casa en busca de pistas sobre lo que pudo pasar.

A Headless History#045.src: Whassat you're lookin' at there? The castle? Don't see why he'd be pointin' this ol' telescope that way.
A Headless History#045.dst: ¿Qué miras ahí? ¿El castillo? No sé por qué apuntaría este viejo telescopio hacia allá.
A Headless History#045.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#046.src: You're human, so you wouldn't know, but somethin' like two hundred years ago, an elf of all people lived in that castle. Called 'imself Dullahan, wore a helmet a lot, I think.
A Headless History#046.dst: Eres humano, así que no lo sabrás, pero hace unos doscientos años, en ese castillo vivía nada menos que un elfo. Se hacía llamar Dullahan, y creo que llevaba casco.
A Headless History#046.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#047.src: People thought he was the reason for the Decay- can't imagine why, personally, and obviously they weren't right.
A Headless History#047.dst: La gente creía que él causó la Decadencia- yo no sé por qué, y está claro que se equivocaban.
A Headless History#047.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#048.src: ...hm. Y'know, there's some ghost stories about Dullahan still livin' in that castle... Come to think of it, I think Referick mentioned a theory about it.
A Headless History#048.dst: ...mm. ¿Sabes?, hay historias de fantasmas de que Dullahan aún vive en ese castillo... Ahora que lo pienso, Referick mencionó una teoría sobre eso.
A Headless History#048.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#049.src: Barely remember what it was about cause of how many crackpots he's stuck his head into, but it's somethin' about a ghost. 's the only lead I can think of, anyways...
A Headless History#049.dst: Apenas recuerdo de qué iba, con tantas chifladuras en las que se ha metido, pero algo de un fantasma. Es la única pista que se me ocurre...
A Headless History#049.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#050.src: The castle door's locked, but you can access the basement. Think you could try lookin' over there? That's all I got.
A Headless History#050.dst: La puerta del castillo está cerrada, pero se puede entrar al sótano. ¿Podrías mirar por allí? Es todo lo que tengo.
A Headless History#050.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#051.src: Travel to the castle in the north at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Headless History#051.dst: Viaja al castillo del norte en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#053.src: ...an unfamiliar soul? Strange. I have not brought you here. I do not know of you.
A Headless History#053.dst: ...¿un alma desconocida? Qué extraño. Yo no te he traído aquí. No sé quién eres.

A Headless History#054.src: What an odd feeling... I haven't felt confusion in a long time. How refreshing...still, I shall ask you to leave.
A Headless History#054.dst: Qué sensación tan rara... Hacía mucho que no sentía confusión. Qué refrescante... aun así, te pediré que te marches.

A Headless History#055.src: Excuse you. I asked you to leave, strange person. You would ignore my request?
A Headless History#055.dst: Perdona. Te pedí que te marcharas, extraño. ¿Vas a ignorar mi petición?

A Headless History#056.src: Such an action is rather insolent, not to mention...interesting. Still, interfering with my business is inexcusable.
A Headless History#056.dst: Tal acto es bastante insolente, por no decir... interesante. Aun así, interferir en mis asuntos es imperdonable.

A Headless History#057.src: Demons of the Prison Guard, I compel you to execute this interloper. Trap their soul for my perusal later.
A Headless History#057.dst: Demonios del Carcelero, os ordeno ejecutar a este intruso. Atrapad su alma para que la examine más tarde.

A Headless History#058.src: Return to Referick with his soul at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Headless History#058.dst: Vuelve con Referick con su alma a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#059.src: OI! Referick!! Wait for me! Ain'tcha need some food and drink first?!
A Headless History#059.dst: ¡EH! ¡¡Referick!! ¡Espérame! ¡¿No necesitas comer y beber algo antes?!
A Headless History#059.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#060.src: The heck did you do?! Referick just bolted out the door like he forgot his wallet or somethin'!
A Headless History#060.dst: ¡¿Qué demonios has hecho?! ¡Referick ha salido disparado por la puerta como si se le olvidara la cartera!
A Headless History#060.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#062.src: C'mon mate, you got up and moved for the first time in days and now you're clammin' up again? Speak to me!
A Headless History#062.dst: Venga, colega, te levantas por primera vez en días ¿y ahora te vuelves a callar? ¡Háblame!
A Headless History#062.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#064.src: YIPE! Never heard 'im scream like that before! Never heard anyone scream like that before! I'd like to never hear anyone scream like that again!
A Headless History#064.dst: ¡UY! ¡Nunca le había oído gritar así! ¡Nunca había oído a nadie gritar así! ¡Y no quiero volver a oírlo jamás!
A Headless History#064.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#065.src: Oh, shut UP Hans! I nearly had my soul devoured, don't DARE give me any chaff when I was RIGHT all along!!
A Headless History#065.dst: ¡CÁLLATE, Hans! ¡Casi me devoran el alma, ni se te OCURRA venirme con tonterías cuando tenía RAZÓN!
A Headless History#065.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#066.src: Agh, alright, alright! Quiet, my ears are ringin'! I'll listen, I'll listen, just quiet!
A Headless History#066.dst: ¡Ay, vale, vale! ¡Baja la voz, que me pitan los oídos! ¡Te escucho, te escucho, pero calla!
A Headless History#066.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#067.src: I knew the disappearances in {p} weren't just because of the risen bodies. People were being left catatonic!! That doesn't happen randomly!
A Headless History#067.dst: ¡Sabía que las desapariciones en {p} no eran solo por los cuerpos alzados! ¡¡La gente quedaba catatónica!! ¡Eso no pasa porque sí!
A Headless History#067.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#068.src: It's Dullahan, I swear on my life! I figured him out and he came after me! He's devouring peoples' souls and siphoning their energy for himself!
A Headless History#068.dst: ¡Es Dullahan, lo juro por mi vida! ¡Le descubrí y vino a por mí! ¡Devora las almas de la gente y absorbe su energía!
A Headless History#068.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#069.src: He's acting from within the castle somehow- Ghostly hands and servants, I'll bet! And that means there's a chance to stop him, if he has to act indirectly!
A Headless History#069.dst: ¡Actúa desde dentro del castillo de algún modo- con manos y siervos fantasmales, seguro! ¡Y si tiene que actuar indirectamente, podemos detenerle!
A Headless History#069.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#070.src: We need to round up the townsfolk, the guards, the military, EVERYONE! We have to storm the castle and stop him before he's able to escape!
A Headless History#070.dst: ¡Hay que reunir a los vecinos, a los guardias, al ejército, a TODOS! ¡Hay que asaltar el castillo y detenerle antes de que escape!
A Headless History#070.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#071.src: ...criminy, you really bit the big one, didn'tcha...look, if he's tryin' to eat people's souls, wouldn't it be smarter to NOT have a huge mob?
A Headless History#071.dst: ...madre mía, sí que te ha dado fuerte, ¿eh?... mira, si quiere comerse almas, ¿no sería más listo NO llevar a una multitud?
A Headless History#071.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#072.src: Wait, wh-what do you mean?! Shouldn't everyone be on high alert? Won't we have a better chance of swarming him all at once?
A Headless History#072.dst: Espera, ¡¿q-qué quieres decir?! ¿No deberíamos estar todos alerta? ¿No tendremos más opciones si le atacamos todos a la vez?
A Headless History#072.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#073.src: He'd have a whole mob of people ready to take from in that case. Sending in one, heavily-armed person, or a small group'd be better.
A Headless History#073.dst: Así tendría una multitud entera de la que alimentarse. Sería mejor mandar a una persona bien armada, o a un grupo pequeño.
A Headless History#073.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#074.src: And, well...a heavily-armed human just rescued ya, Ricky. I think we leave this to 'em. How about it, human? Head up to the castle and look into this for us?
A Headless History#074.dst: Y bueno... un humano bien armado acaba de salvarte, Ricky. Dejémoselo a él. ¿Qué dices, humano? ¿Subes al castillo a investigarlo?
A Headless History#074.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#075.dst: Entra en el castillo de Dullahan.

A Headless History#076.src: The interesting soul arrives once more. Why is it you valued the life of that villager? You risked yourself for his soul.
A Headless History#076.dst: El alma interesante llega de nuevo. ¿Por qué valoraste la vida de ese aldeano? Te arriesgaste por su alma.

A Headless History#077.src: It will not make a difference one way or the other, and so I am doubly confused. The feeling has already grown tiresome.
A Headless History#077.dst: No cambiará nada en un sentido u otro, así que mi confusión es doble. Esta sensación ya me resulta tediosa.

A Headless History#078.src: What purpose have you in this place? Turn over your soul so I may examine it and find out. I am genuinely curious to know...
A Headless History#078.dst: ¿Qué propósito tienes en este lugar? Entrégame tu alma para examinarla y descubrirlo. De verdad siento curiosidad...

A Headless History#080.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#080.dst: ¡Se acabó! ¡Te ato con la luz de Orphion!
A Headless History#080.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#082.src: LARIII! Where are you?! I can help!!
A Headless History#082.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#083.src: Ugh, I saw her with that...THING, but...
A Headless History#083.dst: Uf, la vi con esa... COSA, pero...
A Headless History#083.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#084.src: My visions didn't show an exact enough spot... LARIII?
A Headless History#084.dst: Mis visiones no mostraron el lugar exacto... ¿LARIII?
A Headless History#084.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#085.src: I...what is... What left the land scarred like this?!
A Headless History#085.dst: Yo... ¿qué es... ¡¿Qué dejó la tierra marcada así?!
A Headless History#085.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#086.src: Was...was this their clash...? L-LARI! LARIIII! WHERE ARE YOU?!
A Headless History#086.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#088.src: You are NOT dying on me! I won't allow it! You will LIVE, you hear me?!
A Headless History#088.dst: ¡NO te vas a morir! ¡No lo permitiré! ¡VIVIRÁS, ¿me oyes?!
A Headless History#088.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#089.src: Sit as still as you can, I have healing spells prepared.
A Headless History#089.dst: Quédate lo más quieta que puedas, tengo hechizos de curación preparados.
A Headless History#089.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#090.src: I ask the land for its life to save another. Grant me this!
A Headless History#090.dst: Pido a la tierra su vida para salvar otra. ¡Concédemelo!
A Headless History#090.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#092.src: Oh, what am I going to do with you...
A Headless History#092.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#094.src: Once again you ignore my demands...? And not only that, you invade the memories I have locked away?
A Headless History#094.dst: ¿Otra vez ignoras mis órdenes...? ¿Y no solo eso, sino que invades los recuerdos que tengo encerrados?
A Headless History#094.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#095.src: I must ask again, what is your goal? Why have you come here, and why do you seek my most private thoughts, that not even I wish to think?
A Headless History#095.dst: Debo preguntarlo de nuevo, ¿cuál es tu meta? ¿Por qué has venido, y por qué buscas mis pensamientos más íntimos, que ni yo quiero pensar?
A Headless History#095.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#096.src: Look, Dulla, I really do appreciate your help, but you know I can't do what you're asking of me! There's another way, I just need to find it!
A Headless History#096.dst: Mira, Dulla, te agradezco mucho tu ayuda, ¡pero sabes que no puedo hacer lo que me pides! ¡Hay otra forma, solo tengo que encontrarla!
A Headless History#096.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#097.src: Lari, you remember that I have my visions, right? I've seen what will happen if you don't step up- and I can help stop it!
A Headless History#097.dst: Lari, recuerdas que tengo visiones, ¿verdad? He visto lo que pasará si no das un paso al frente- ¡y puedo ayudar a evitarlo!
A Headless History#097.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#098.src: You've been trying to find "anotherway" for two centuries. Don't you think it's high-time we took my route, before things get worse?
A Headless History#098.dst: Llevas dos siglos buscando "otra forma". ¿No crees que ya es hora de seguir mi camino, antes de que todo empeore?
A Headless History#098.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#099.src: NO! I am not going to kill it! YOU are not going to kill it! I'll find a way! I will, I have these powers for a reason!
A Headless History#099.dst: ¡NO! ¡No voy a matarla! ¡TÚ no vas a matarla! ¡Encontraré una forma! ¡Lo haré, tengo estos poderes por algo!
A Headless History#099.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#100.src: You talk a big game, and you show one too, but the creature wasn't fazed. I'm not fazed. Drop the intimidating act, please.
A Headless History#100.dst: Hablas mucho y te haces la dura, pero a la criatura no le afectó. A mí tampoco. Deja el numerito de intimidar, por favor.
A Headless History#100.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#101.src: I...there...there has to be a way. I...I-I'm terrified that I've...already ruined everything, just by following my heart, like I was told...
A Headless History#101.dst: Yo... tiene... tiene que haber una forma. Yo... m-me aterra haberlo... arruinado ya todo, solo por seguir a mi corazón, como me dijeron...
A Headless History#101.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#102.src: I know you're frustrated, but I am too. I left a lot behind to try and help you. I hate to say these things, I wish it could be your way.
A Headless History#102.dst: Sé que estás frustrada, pero yo también. Dejé mucho atrás para intentar ayudarte. Odio decir esto, ojalá pudiera ser a tu manera.
A Headless History#102.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#103.src: I'm terrified too, that if we don't take more drastic action, things will get worse. Can't you see that, too?
A Headless History#103.dst: Yo también tengo miedo de que, si no tomamos medidas drásticas, todo empeore. ¿No lo ves tú también?
A Headless History#103.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#104.src: I...I just... I don't know what to do!
A Headless History#104.dst: ¡Yo... es que... no sé qué hacer!
A Headless History#104.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#105.src: He showed me all these things and gave me all these choices and asked how my heart beat!
A Headless History#105.dst: ¡Me mostró todas esas cosas, me dio todas esas opciones y me preguntó cómo latía mi corazón!
A Headless History#105.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#106.src: He gave me these powers but they don't work or I don't know HOW they work!
A Headless History#106.dst: ¡Me dio estos poderes, pero no funcionan o no sé CÓMO funcionan!
A Headless History#106.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#107.src: I want to do the right thing but I don't know what it is and I don't know how to ask what it is and...a-and...
A Headless History#107.dst: Quiero hacer lo correcto, pero no sé qué es, y no sé cómo preguntar qué es, y... y-y...
A Headless History#107.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#108.src: You have become infuriating instead of interesting. Why do you violate my memories? Why do you force me to relive them?
A Headless History#108.dst: Has pasado de interesante a exasperante. ¿Por qué profanas mis recuerdos? ¿Por qué me obligas a revivirlos?
A Headless History#108.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#109.src: Spirit of the Keeper of Keys, rid me of this thing that befouls my place. It incites a rage akin to HER.
A Headless History#109.dst: Espíritu del Guardián de las Llaves, líbrame de esto que mancilla mi hogar. Me enfurece como ELLA.
A Headless History#109.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#110.src: You...are a fool. More than I was. You knowingly walk to your death.
A Headless History#110.dst: Tú... eres un necio. Más que yo. Caminas hacia tu muerte a sabiendas.
A Headless History#110.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#111.src: It is convenient for me, certainly, but I admit that it is equal parts enraging and bewildering.
A Headless History#111.dst: Me conviene, desde luego, pero admito que me resulta a partes iguales irritante y desconcertante.
A Headless History#111.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#112.src: Leave the room and continue exploring the castle.
A Headless History#112.dst: Sal de la sala y sigue explorando el castillo.

A Headless History#113.src: I told you, Lari! I saw it in my visions, this is our last chance! Hurry!
A Headless History#113.dst: ¡Te lo dije, Lari! ¡Lo vi en mis visiones, es nuestra última ocasión! ¡Deprisa!
A Headless History#113.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#114.src: Look at this spot, Lari. It has to be here. The land is being scarred, just like after your fight. The light is being drained!
A Headless History#114.dst: Mira este sitio, Lari. Tiene que ser aquí. La tierra se está marcando, como tras tu combate. ¡La luz se está agotando!
A Headless History#114.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#115.src: This must be where the parasite burrowed down... You're... You're right. We have to...to do something.
A Headless History#115.dst: Aquí debe de ser donde se enterró el parásito... Tienes... Tienes razón. Tenemos que... hacer algo.
A Headless History#115.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#116.src: I... I'm not sure if I'm ready, but you're right. We need to do this...
A Headless History#116.dst: No... no sé si estoy lista, pero tienes razón. Tenemos que hacerlo...
A Headless History#116.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#117.src: ...Remember what I said. You HAVE to take action. There's only two outcomes here.
A Headless History#117.dst: ...Recuerda lo que te dije. TIENES que actuar. Aquí solo hay dos desenlaces.
A Headless History#117.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#119.src: We'll need to dig... Do you think you could help with that, Dulla?
A Headless History#119.dst: Habrá que cavar... ¿Crees que podrías ayudar con eso, Dulla?
A Headless History#119.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#120.src: Of course, Lari. We'll need everything we can get if we're going to kill that horrendous thing.
A Headless History#120.dst: Claro, Lari. Necesitaremos todo lo posible si vamos a matar a esa cosa horrenda.
A Headless History#120.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#122.src: I see it! Lari, it's time!
A Headless History#122.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#123.src: ...I will show you an exit, interloper. It would be...wise of you to take it.
A Headless History#123.dst: ...Te mostraré una salida, intruso. Sería... sensato que la tomaras.
A Headless History#123.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#124.src: You are a damned fool, interloper. Dredging my memories as you have... I have never felt such rage, not in a long time.
A Headless History#124.dst: Eres un maldito necio, intruso. Removiendo así mis recuerdos... Hacía mucho tiempo que no sentía semejante ira.
A Headless History#124.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#125.src: As such, it shall end now. The exit I spoke of will not free you from the castle, as you can see.
A Headless History#125.dst: Por ello, esto termina ahora. La salida de la que hablé no te librará del castillo, como puedes ver.
A Headless History#125.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#126.src: Warden of Wisdom! I compel you- Rid me of this miscreant! Erase every trace of it from this existence...
A Headless History#126.dst: ¡Guardián de la Sabiduría! Te ordeno- ¡Líbrame de este canalla! Borra todo rastro suyo de esta existencia...
A Headless History#126.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#127.src: ...save for a corpse, for me to toss at Lari's feet.
A Headless History#127.dst: ...salvo un cadáver, para arrojarlo a los pies de Lari.
A Headless History#127.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#128.src: GAH! It was never able to do this before...! W-What happened to it?!
A Headless History#128.dst: ¡AGH! ¡Nunca había podido hacer esto...! ¡¿Q-Qué le ha pasado?!
A Headless History#128.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#129.src: AWAY! You keep away from us!!
A Headless History#129.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#130.src: Lari, you need to get up, now! We can't waste this chance!
A Headless History#130.dst: ¡Lari, tienes que levantarte, ya! ¡No podemos desperdiciar esta ocasión!
A Headless History#130.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#131.src: It...it threw me aside like nothing! How is it overpowering Orphion's light...?
A Headless History#131.dst: ¡Me... me apartó como si nada! ¿Cómo puede superar la luz de Orphion...?
A Headless History#131.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#132.src: It's overpowering you because you're not attacking! Remember what I said? You have to-
A Headless History#132.dst: ¡Te supera porque no atacas! ¿Recuerdas lo que dije? Tienes que-
A Headless History#132.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#133.src: ...wait, where did it...did we lose it already?!
A Headless History#133.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#135.src: It's shrugging my attacks off, Lari! Come on, do SOMETHING!
A Headless History#135.dst: ¡Mis ataques no le hacen nada, Lari! ¡Vamos, haz ALGO!
A Headless History#135.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#137.src: I...No! It's happening just like I saw! She's...
A Headless History#137.dst: Yo... ¡No! ¡Está pasando tal como lo vi! Ella...
A Headless History#137.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#138.src: I need to get to her, push her to the killing blow...
A Headless History#138.dst: Tengo que llegar hasta ella, empujarla a dar el golpe final...
A Headless History#138.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#139.src: Be still, creature! I compel you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#139.dst: ¡Quieta, criatura! ¡Te lo ordeno con la luz de Orphion!
A Headless History#139.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#140.src: LARIIII! THIS IS THE LAST CHANCE YOU HAVE! DON'T TRAP IT, KILL IT!
A Headless History#140.dst: ¡LARIIII! ¡ES TU ÚLTIMA OCASIÓN! ¡NO LA ATRAPES, MÁTALA!
A Headless History#140.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#141.src: I-I'm...Dulla, I'm- I can't! I know I can keep it held this time!!
A Headless History#141.dst: ¡Y-Yo... Dulla, yo- no puedo! ¡¡Sé que esta vez puedo retenerla!!
A Headless History#141.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#143.src: I...I-I...th-the light is...I c-can't hold onto it...i-is it...it's t-taking...g-guh...
A Headless History#143.dst: Yo... y-yo... l-la luz... n-no puedo sujetarla... ¿e-está...? me la está q-quitando... g-guh...
A Headless History#143.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#144.src: Lari! You can't reason with it! You can't hold it! You have to put Gavel first! US first!!
A Headless History#144.dst: ¡Lari! ¡No puedes razonar con ella! ¡No puedes retenerla! ¡Pon a Gavel primero! ¡¡A NOSOTROS primero!!
A Headless History#144.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#145.src: I won't let what you predicted happen! I know I can change fate!!
A Headless History#145.dst: ¡No dejaré que pase lo que predijiste! ¡¡Sé que puedo cambiar el destino!!
A Headless History#145.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#146.src: Please work, please work! D-Don't break, I can't-
A Headless History#146.dst: ¡Funciona, por favor, funciona! N-No te rompas, no puedo-
A Headless History#146.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#147.src: Lari, no! If it bites you we're doomed! GET UP!
A Headless History#147.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#150.src: L-Lari...we...e-everything happened like I s-said...you...you didn't...l-listen...
A Headless History#150.dst: L-Lari... todo... t-todo pasó como d-dije... tú... tú no... e-escuchaste...
A Headless History#150.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#151.src: No! No it didn't happen like you said! I-I can fix this! Y-You'll be alright! You'll be alright, you hear me?! I'll make sure of it!
A Headless History#151.dst: ¡No! ¡No pasó como dijiste! ¡P-Puedo arreglarlo! ¡T-Te pondrás bien! Te pondrás bien, ¡¿me oyes?! ¡Yo me encargaré!
A Headless History#151.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#152.src: ...so I am cursed to bear witness to my most painful memories due to your idiocy. It is almost a fitting penance... Almost, but not quite.
A Headless History#152.dst: ...así que estoy condenado a presenciar mis recuerdos más dolorosos por tu idiotez. Es casi una penitencia apropiada... Casi, pero no del todo.
A Headless History#152.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#154.src: My rage... My memories... Your presence stirs them in kind. You must disappear, I no longer care to see your soul.
A Headless History#154.dst: Mi ira... Mis recuerdos... Tu presencia los agita por igual. Debes desaparecer, ya no me interesa ver tu alma.
A Headless History#154.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#155.src: Sit still and allow yourself to be engulfed. It will save me further pain.
A Headless History#155.dst: Quédate quieto y deja que te engulla. Me ahorrará más dolor.
A Headless History#155.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#156.src: Lari...? Where are you? I...I need you... Why are you gone? Why do you ignore me?
A Headless History#156.dst: ¿Lari...? ¿Dónde estás? Yo... te necesito... ¿Por qué te has ido? ¿Por qué me ignoras?
A Headless History#156.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#157.src: My magic is fading, I can't see my visions... They're clearer around you... Please, come back...
A Headless History#157.dst: Mi magia se apaga, no puedo ver mis visiones... Son más claras cerca de ti... Por favor, vuelve...
A Headless History#157.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#158.src: That elf girl's off in the forest. Don't know what she's doing but this is our shot!
A Headless History#158.dst: La elfa se ha ido al bosque. No sé qué hace, ¡pero esta es nuestra oportunidad!
A Headless History#158.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#159.src: We can finally execute the person causing the decay in the forest! {p} will be saved!
A Headless History#159.dst: ¡Por fin podremos ejecutar al culpable de la Decadencia del bosque! ¡{p} se salvará!
A Headless History#159.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#160.src: You prepared the sleeping spell, right? Who knows if we'll get a chance like this again.
A Headless History#160.dst: Preparaste el hechizo de sueño, ¿verdad? Quién sabe si tendremos otra ocasión así.
A Headless History#160.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#163.src: L-Lari? Is...is that you? Did you finally come back...?
A Headless History#163.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#164.src: Nah, not quite. Say, why don't you go to sleep 'til she comes back? Dream sweet dreams...
A Headless History#164.dst: No, no exactamente. Oye, ¿por qué no duermes hasta que vuelva? Dulces sueños...
A Headless History#164.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#165.src: ...they'll be the last ones you ever have, grimy demon. To the guillotine with you... Everyone! I got him!
A Headless History#165.dst: ...serán los últimos que tengas, demonio inmundo. A la guillotina contigo... ¡Todos! ¡Le tengo!
A Headless History#165.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#166.src: Everyone, welcome! Today will be the day we save our fair land. Today's the day of light!
A Headless History#166.dst: ¡Bienvenidos todos! Hoy es el día en que salvaremos nuestra bella tierra. ¡Hoy es el día de la luz!
A Headless History#166.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#167.src: Dullahan has been captured! We have the cursed progenitor of the decay in our grip- to be executed, once and for all!
A Headless History#167.dst: ¡Hemos capturado a Dullahan! Tenemos al maldito origen de la Decadencia- ¡será ejecutado de una vez por todas!
A Headless History#167.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#168.src: Haha, yeah! Shoulda thought twice before cursing OUR homes! Three cheers for our wizards!!
A Headless History#168.dst: ¡Jaja, eso! ¡Debió pensárselo antes de maldecir NUESTROS hogares! ¡¡Tres hurras por nuestros magos!!
A Headless History#168.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#169.src: The decay will clear up- We'll spill his blood, chop off his head, and the curse will be lifted!!
A Headless History#169.dst: ¡La Decadencia desaparecerá- derramaremos su sangre, le cortaremos la cabeza y se romperá la maldición!
A Headless History#169.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#170.src: Ladies and gentlemen, folks of all shapes and sizes, it's time to take our lives back!
A Headless History#170.dst: Damas y caballeros, gentes de todas formas y tamaños, ¡es hora de recuperar nuestras vidas!
A Headless History#170.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#174.src: Dullahan? I'm...I'm back. I didn't leave you for long, I just was trying to find the cu-
A Headless History#174.dst: ¿Dullahan? He... he vuelto. No te dejé mucho tiempo, solo intentaba encontrar la cu-
A Headless History#174.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#175.src: ...uh? Dullahan? He's...he's been right here to greet me almost every day for the past twenty years...
A Headless History#175.dst: ...¿eh? ¿Dullahan? Él... ha estado aquí para recibirme casi cada día durante los últimos veinte años...
A Headless History#175.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#176.src: Footprints...? Dullaaaa? Where'd you go? Is everything alright, did something happen?
A Headless History#176.dst: ¿Huellas...? ¿Dullaaaa? ¿Adónde has ido? ¿Va todo bien, ha pasado algo?
A Headless History#176.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#179.src: I...I l-left for...an hour, a-and...and they... Why?
A Headless History#179.dst: Yo... me f-fui... una hora, y-y... y ellos... ¿Por qué?
A Headless History#179.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#180.src: Why did they do this to you...? I...h-how can I possibly fix this?!
A Headless History#180.dst: ¿Por qué te han hecho esto...? Yo... ¡¿c-cómo voy a arreglar esto?!
A Headless History#180.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#181.src: I cannot understand why you continue to defile me with these horrid memories. What do you hope to find?
A Headless History#181.dst: No entiendo por qué sigues profanándome con estos horribles recuerdos. ¿Qué esperas encontrar?
A Headless History#181.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#182.src: I am once more curious. If only to know what I could possibly do or say to cease this horrid quest you've given yourself.
A Headless History#182.dst: De nuevo siento curiosidad. Aunque sea por saber qué hacer o decir para frenar esta horrible búsqueda tuya.
A Headless History#182.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#183.src: Th-this has to work. It WILL work! I know it will! I...I d-don't know if it will... I have to fix this, I have to...
A Headless History#183.dst: E-Esto tiene que funcionar. ¡FUNCIONARÁ! ¡Lo sé! Yo... n-no sé si funcionará... Tengo que arreglarlo, tengo que...
A Headless History#183.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#184.src: The waters from the Lazarus Pit are fabled for bringing back the dead... If this doesn't work, I...
A Headless History#184.dst: Dicen las leyendas que las aguas del Pozo de Lazarus devuelven a los muertos... Si esto no funciona, yo...
A Headless History#184.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#185.src: I can't think about that. This...this WILL work. I promise. I found a way to fix it... It has to.
A Headless History#185.dst: No puedo pensar en eso. Esto... FUNCIONARÁ. Lo prometo. Hallé la forma de arreglarlo... Tiene que funcionar.
A Headless History#185.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#186.src: P-Please...w-whatever gods are out there, whoever is listening, hear me...bring Dullahan back to me, I'm begging you...
A Headless History#186.dst: P-Por favor... dioses que haya ahí fuera, quien me escuche, oídme... devolvedme a Dullahan, os lo suplico...
A Headless History#186.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#187.src: It's... I-Is it reacting? It... It looks like it is, but...h-he's not mending...
A Headless History#187.dst: ¿Está... e-está reaccionando? Pa... Parece que sí, pero... n-no se recupera...
A Headless History#187.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#188.src: N-No, this...i-it isn't...NO! It... It HAS to work! I...I can m-make this work!
A Headless History#188.dst: N-No, esto... n-no... ¡NO! ¡TIENE que funcionar! ¡Puedo h-hacer que funcione!
A Headless History#188.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#191.src: I...I t-told you... I knew I could change fate... I'm so glad you're here...
A Headless History#191.dst: Te... te l-lo dije... Podía cambiar el destino... Qué alegría que estés aquí...
A Headless History#191.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#192.src: It's odd. If it were not for her, I would not be here. I would not have my power. Yet even thinking her name enrages me.
A Headless History#192.dst: Qué extraño. Si no fuera por ella, no estaría aquí. No tendría mi poder. Pero solo pensar en su nombre me enfurece.
A Headless History#192.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#193.src: Enter the last door in the dining hall.
A Headless History#193.dst: Entra por la última puerta del comedor.

A Headless History#195.src: H...h-hrk...g-gah, what is...wh-what... You...you didn't really...?
A Headless History#195.dst: H...h-hrk... g-gah, ¿qué es... q-qué... Tú... no habrás...?
A Headless History#195.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#196.src: Th-there's so much death... The...the air smells like b-blood...
A Headless History#196.dst: H-Hay tanta muerte... El... el aire huele a s-sangre...
A Headless History#196.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#197.src: This isn't... There has to be s-some other reason, I... I can't have b-brought back a...a...
A Headless History#197.dst: Esto no es... Tiene que haber o-otra razón, yo... No puedo haber t-traído de vuelta a un... un...
A Headless History#197.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#198.src: P-Please, we can't afford to lose more people! There's hardly any farmers in the fields anymore, I-I'm needed elsewhere!
A Headless History#198.dst: ¡P-Por favor, no podemos perder a más gente! ¡Casi no quedan granjeros en los campos, m-me necesitan en otra parte!
A Headless History#198.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#199.src: The last few said similar things. Someone else I knew said similar things. Frankly, I do not care. Present your soul to me, now.
A Headless History#199.dst: Los últimos dijeron cosas parecidas. Alguien a quien conocí dijo cosas parecidas. Francamente, no me importa. Entrégame tu alma, ya.
A Headless History#199.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#200.src: DULLAHAN! What...w-what are you doing?! I... I can't believe my eyes...
A Headless History#200.dst: ¡DULLAHAN! ¡¿Q-Qué estás haciendo?! No puedo creer lo que veo...
A Headless History#200.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#201.src: I... I tried to help you! I t-tried so hard at everything we did together... How could you do this to them?! To...to me?
A Headless History#201.dst: ¡Yo... intenté ayudarte! Me esforcé t-tanto en todo lo que hicimos juntos... ¡¿Cómo has podido hacerles esto?! ¿A... a mí?
A Headless History#201.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#202.src: Odd. I recall you explicitly denying the only option that would have prevented this. I warned you quite thoroughly.
A Headless History#202.dst: Qué extraño. Recuerdo que rechazaste de forma explícita la única opción que habría evitado esto. Te advertí a fondo.
A Headless History#202.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#203.src: You have had many chances to end this, Lari. Do you expect me to feel sympathy, when your own actions have made me feel nothing?
A Headless History#203.dst: Has tenido muchas ocasiones de acabar con esto, Lari. ¿Esperas que sienta compasión, cuando tus propios actos me han hecho no sentir nada?
A Headless History#203.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#204.src: This...this isn't like you... You would never have done this before! You dedicated your life to trying to help...so w-why are you...m...m-m... I-I'm leaving!!
A Headless History#204.dst: Esto... esto no es propio de ti... ¡Antes nunca habrías hecho esto! Dedicaste tu vida a ayudar... así que ¿p-por qué...? m... m-m... ¡¡M-Me voy!!
A Headless History#204.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#205.src: What have I done...? This...he's... He's not th-the same anymore... What changed? Is this my fault...? I c-can't understand it...
A Headless History#205.dst: ¿Qué he hecho...? Esto... él... Ya no es el m-mismo... ¿Qué ha cambiado? ¿Es culpa mía...? N-No lo entiendo...
A Headless History#205.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#206.src: ...but...I'll... I'll protect them. I'll protect him... I...there has to be a way. But...until I find it...
A Headless History#206.dst: ...pero... los protegeré. Le protegeré a él... Tiene que haber una forma. Pero... hasta que la encuentre...
A Headless History#206.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#207.src: ...goodbye. Goodbye until the day comes when I can fill you with light once more. Goodbye until you learn... Goodbye, until I can fix you...
A Headless History#207.dst: ...adiós. Adiós hasta el día en que pueda volver a llenarte de luz. Adiós hasta que aprendas... Adiós, hasta que pueda arreglarte...
A Headless History#207.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#208.dst: Adiós, Dullahan... Te echaré de menos.
A Headless History#208.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#209.src: Investigate the dark door at the end of the castle.
A Headless History#209.dst: Investiga la puerta oscura al fondo del castillo.
